This Privacy Policy describes how Ahmad YT Tutorial ("we," "us," "our," or "this website") collects, uses, and protects information when you visit our website. By using this website, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

Information We Collect
We may collect limited, non-personally identifiable information automatically when you visit our site, such as approximate location (country/region), device and browser type, pages visited, and time spent on the site. This is used solely for analytics purposes to help us understand and improve our content. If you voluntarily contact us via email, WhatsApp, or social media, we collect the information you choose to provide, such as your name and email address, solely to respond to your inquiry.

Cookies and Similar Technologies
Like most websites, we may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to store certain information, improve site functionality, and analyze traffic. You can choose to disable cookies through your individual browser settings; however, this may affect the functionality of certain parts of the website.

This website may display advertisements served by Google AdSense and other third-party advertising partners. These third parties may use cookies, web beacons, or similar technologies to collect information about your visits to this and other websites in order to provide advertisements about goods and services of interest to you.

- Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies (such as the DoubleClick DART cookie) to serve ads based on your prior visits to this website or other websites.
- Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet.
- You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings at https://adssettings.google.com, and you may also visit https://www.aboutads.info to opt out of third-party vendor cookies.

We do not control the cookies placed by third-party advertisers, and this Privacy Policy does not cover their use of cookies or tracking technologies. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of these third parties for more detailed information.

Analytics
We may use website analytics tools to collect aggregated, anonymized data about how visitors use our site (such as page views and general geographic region). This data helps us improve our content and user experience and is not used to personally identify individual visitors.

Children's Privacy
This website does not knowingly collect any personally identifiable information from children under the age of 13. Our content is not directed at children, and we comply with applicable regulations, including the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can promptly remove it.

Our website may contain links to third-party websites, including YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, and WhatsApp. We have no control over and assume no responsibility for the content, privacy policies, or practices of any third-party sites or services.
